candidate.source_state: uncommitted working tree on top of the parent head; this subagent does not commit or push

authority.macro_body: IMPLEMENT_LEGACY_EVP_MD_METH(_LC) emits `return fn##_Init(EVP_MD_CTX_get0_md_data(ctx))` with no NULL test on ctx or md_data; the SHA-3/SHAKE initialisers additionally read ctx->digest->md_size. key2text_newctx/freectx are static provider callbacks: newctx returns provctx, freectx is empty.

defect.class: write or read through a NULL / caller-unestablished md_data and digest
defect.reachability: EVP_MD_meth_get_init (src/evp/digest.rs; libcrypto.ld) returns the callback to any C caller. A fresh EVP_MD_CTX_new() is zero-filled, so md_data and digest are NULL; a NULL ctx dereferences NULL as well. The getter's documented contract does not establish either precondition.

reproduction.authority: Eight one-process C probes against the pinned 3.6.4 install, four digests x {fresh EVP_MD_CTX_new(), NULL ctx}: every probe printed md_data=(nil) digest=(nil) (fresh) or ctx=NULL and exited 139 (SIGSEGV).

reproduction.after_fix_candidate: The four focused tests pass (1 passed each, 0 failed) and the bound paths produce MDC2 init=1, SHA3-256("abc")=3a985da7..., SHAKE128 init=1, SM3("abc")=66c7f0f4...

fix.shape: Each of the four legacy initialisers calls a private init helper before writing. MDC2 and SM3 use init_md_data(ctx, owner, size), the same contract as the hardened SHA-1/SHA-224/MD5/BLAKE2 initialisers: it refuses a NULL ctx, NULL md_data, NULL digest and a method whose ctx_size is smaller than the digest context. SHA-3/SHAKE use init_keccak(ctx, owners), which applies the same checks over the set of table objects the shared callback is installed on and additionally requires a positive digest md_size. A refusal answers 0, the C initialise failure value, touching no memory.
fix.normal_path: A context bound to the callback's own table object (or to a method with ctx_size >= the digest context) still calls the authority's *_Init/ossl_sha3_init and returns its value. Digest maths and result values are unchanged.
fix.key2text: The two provider callbacks were safe all along: the `unsafe` marker was vestigial. It was removed; they are now safe extern "C" fns with no unsafe operation left.
fix.authority_comparison: §17 divergence, not compatibility: the authority performs the NULL write/read and faults. The crate does not reproduce UB; it returns 0 on exactly the shapes where the authority does not return. Recorded as D-LEGACY-MD-INIT-MD-DATA-2 in docs/SECURITY_DIVERGENCE_POLICY.md.
